rfq_details.title: Bulk Windshield Washer Fluid Supply — 3-Year Municipal Contract
rfq_details.project_name: Bulk Windshield Washer Fluid Supply — 3-Year Municipal Contract

introduction: DEE DAVIS INC is requesting competitive wholesale pricing for bulk windshield washer fluid to fulfill a 3-year municipal fleet contract in Metro Detroit, Michigan. We are seeking a reliable Michigan-based supplier who can provide consistent quality product, competitive bulk pricing, and dependable delivery to the Detroit metropolitan area.

scope_of_work.title: SCOPE OF WORK
scope_of_work.description: The selected supplier will provide bulk windshield washer fluid in three temperature blends on an as-needed basis over a 36-month contract period. Estimated annual volume is 25,000-30,000 gallons. Delivery to Detroit metro area facilities required within 48-72 hours of order. Supplier must maintain adequate inventory to fulfill orders year-round, including peak winter demand.
key_requirements: All products must meet applicable ASTM and DOT standards for windshield washer fluid
Supplier must maintain stock of all three blends year-round
Delivery within 48-72 hours of order to Metro Detroit
Packaging: 55-gallon drums and/or 275-gallon totes (quote both options)
Price protection or escalation caps for 36-month contract term
Safety Data Sheets (SDS) required for all products
Minimum order quantity must be specified

items.specifications: Effective to 32°F, meets ASTM standards, blue dye
Effective to -20°F, methanol-based, meets DOT standards

submission_requirements.title: QUOTE SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS
items: PRICING: Provide complete unit pricing for each line item with any volume discounts
MANUFACTURER INFO: Include manufacturer name and part number for each item
DELIVERY: Specify lead time in business days and confirm FOB terms (destination preferred)
SHIPPING: State whether freight is included in pricing or quote separately
QUOTE FORMAT: Respond via email with itemized pricing in Excel/PDF format
PAYMENT TERMS: State your standard payment terms (Net 30, Net 60, etc.)
QUOTE VALIDITY: Confirm how long pricing remains valid
CONTACT INFO: Include primary contact name, phone, and email for follow-up questions

items.title: Payment Terms
items.description: Net 30 days from invoice date. Purchase orders will be issued upon award.

items.title: Delivery Requirements
items.description: FOB Destination preferred (freight included in price). Specify lead times for each item.

items.title: Contract Period
items.description: 36 months (3 years) with option to extend based on performance.

items.title: Product Quality
items.description: All products must be new, first-quality merchandise meeting manufacturer specifications.

items.title: Returns & Warranties
items.description: Defective items must be replaced within 5 business days at no charge.

items.title: Price Protection
items.description: Quoted prices remain firm for contract period unless mutually agreed in writing.
